findings.title: Internal directory symlinks bypass the no-symlink component-path rule
findings.reproduction: Start with the valid synthetic RLE package. Copy objects.jsonl to real/objects.jsonl, create alias -> real inside the package, change components.objects.path to alias/objects.jsonl while preserving its correct digest. check_package accepted the package and candidate_projection produced three candidates.
findings.cause: Only the final path entry was lstat-checked; ancestor directory symlinks inside the root passed resolution containment.
findings.impact: Mismatch with the specified no-symlink gate. The reproduction stays inside the package root and preserves hashes; it does not establish a rights bypass, an out-of-root read, or a digest bypass.
findings.requested_fix: Reject symlinks on every component below the supplied package root; preserve support for ordinary nested directories.
findings.fix: Maintainer changed safe_file to reject absolute/parent traversal paths and lstat each component below the supplied package root: real directories for intermediate entries and a regular final file. Source inspection confirmed the change.

before.result: IER-01 assertion fails with empty validation errors; both INT-01 checks and regular nested-directory positive control pass.

after.result: All three focused independent regressions pass; regular nested path validates and yields three proposals, directory symlink is rejected and yields zero proposals.

findings.independent_verification: The same independent script was executed before and after the fix; the original failing behavior is retained in C04/C07 and the raw probes, and the corrected behavior in C08.

findings.title: Exhausted dependency counter must block publication after an unrecordable revocation
findings.discovered_by: root integration reviewer, not the independent reviewer
findings.observed_before_fix: Root reported that change(authority, revoked=True) raised at MAX_EPOCH but publish of the unchanged read set returned True. This review did not execute the pre-fix version.
findings.fix: publish now rejects if any current dependency epoch equals MAX_EPOCH.
findings.independent_verification: Constructed authority epoch MAX_EPOCH with generation zero, observed change(..., revoked=True) raise ProfileError, then verified old and fresh read sets both fail to publish and head stays None. Also advanced MAX_EPOCH-1 through the final normal change and verified fresh publication fails with head None.
findings.scope: In-memory epoch/revocation subset only; output grants, semantic validity, build checks and distributed persistence are not established.

critical_gate_results.evidence: Both classes validate as private packages with no license and empty publishable_layers, and emit zero projection rows. Adding CC-BY-4.0 plus knowledge publication causes validation errors and zero rows. Existing regression suite additionally exercises license/layer combinations and render refusal.

Independent mutations of unsupported result, same_session_agent, same reviewer/producer identity, incomplete relation scope, candidate object, and failed/unknown/empty extraction checks cannot retain knowledge_ready and produce no export proposals. Existing suite also exercises partial reviews, all object/relation statuses, sample counts, missing object scope and assessment references.

An incorrect review objects hash and changed semantic text without review rebinding are rejected. Existing ledger/render tests exercised accepted-edit overlap even with an empty declared dependency list, stale relation propagation and exact replay. The separate independent stale-edit mutation failed at replay, so it is not counted as an isolated test of anchor-impact detection.

critical_gate_results.gate: Status derivation and legal unverified state
critical_gate_results.evidence: Existing test group executed the finite 3,240-combination derivation table. Independent unverified representation with partial_pilot accepted. The first independent probe used nonexistent knowledge_partial; that was a reviewer error, preserved and corrected, not a defect.

Read source for immutable snapshot validation, internal rendering and digest projection; existing tests executed arbitrary-input refusal, render hash binding, full-record retention and adversarial Markdown heading/fence cases. IER-01 was a separate explicit component-path mismatch, now fixed and independently retested with a normal nested-directory positive control.

critical_gate_results.gate: Strict exchange JSON and finite epochs
critical_gate_results.evidence: Independent decoder probes reject duplicate and nested duplicate members, overflow 1e999, NaN, UTF-8 BOM, and escaped surrogate keys/values. Existing tests additionally exercise exact-byte digest identity, event monotonicity and rollback/ABA. INT-01 retested independently.

Final checker confirms 283 numbered requirements match the source register; final AST inspection resolves all 18 cited methods, including the added BPK-R005 path regression. These finite references are examples, not proof of complete clause implementation.

critical_gate_results.gate: API receipt shape and decision vocabulary
critical_gate_results.evidence: Five tests run as part of C02, including 2,187 combinations, required checks and path/identity/date controls. The harness explicitly supplies the existing UTC-seconds format checker; it does not establish all RFC3339 support or default-validator format assertions.

review_scope.source_inspection: AGENTS.md; original ES01–ES28 review; book schema, validator, fixture builder, builder and regression tests; book specification; contract-observation schema and full bounded validator/model; relevant cache/status/profile boundaries; API receipt schema and test harness; requirement-register generator and references. Some long file reads were partial or truncated: this is not a claim of line-by-line review of every specification and test.
review_scope.hash_scope_note: The hash inventory covers the implemented review surface and related registered specifications/fixtures. Hashing a file is not evidence that every line was reviewed.
